This unit features beautiful hardwood floors throughout, upgraded thermopane windows and a spacious main level with an open living and dining area. A versatile first-floor bedroom with an adjacent full bath is ideal as a guest room or home office. The efficient kitchen flows easily into the living space, while upstairs, the private primary suite offers a large walk-in closet and full bath. Your private back door through the kitchen leads to your garage bay your large storage space. Village Walk offers unmatched in-town living-nearby train station, library, Norwalk River Valley Trail, grocery stores, pharmacy, restaurants, and public transportation. Paired with Wilton's schools, this condo combines comfort, convenience, and community in a truly sought-after location.
